segments.title: Pepito Cold Open & Studio Setup
segments.notes: Pepito delivers musical sign-on; Case adjusts stream effects, removes fish tie, acknowledges Friday sacred duties (DJC4 song request and Beyblade tournament).

segments.title: ICE Raids in Chicago & Federal Protest Response
segments.notes: Case and Rick discuss Operation Midway Blitz: 300 agents, Blackhawk repelling, 37 arrests including U.S. citizen children, Kristi Noem facility visit, Broadview mayor standoff, state police deployment, and protest footage.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Returns from the Wall
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon reappears claiming cosmic wall-being resilience; segment watches viral videos (CD destruction, ice cream truck, card tricks, soccer cleats, ghost kick, yacht story, 'duty ass' pitch, James Gunn PG Porn).

segments.title: Movie Trailer Block
segments.notes: Case and Chris review trailers: Muzzle: City of Wolves, The Carpenter's Son (Nic Cage), Good Night and Good Luck (Broadway), Bugs Bunny Cartoon Carnival; debate over 1950s nostalgia and Pepe Le Pew.

segments.title: Rapid-Fire Discord News Roundup
segments.notes: Case reads chat-submitted stories: Shondi Combs sentencing, Adidas pet tracksuits, Chinese flying wind turbine, Joe Wicks protein bar stunt, RFK Jr. sneeze, AI film 'The Sweet Idleness', Waymo safety stats, Andrew Cuomo AI mayoral ad, Trump Truth Social AI posts.

segments.title: Beyblade Tournament: 143 Points on the Line
segments.notes: Best-of-19 Beyblade Burst match; Kendall serves as Crum's second (Team Blue) then Munch plays himself (Team Red); Munch wins 15-3, claims 301 total points, reduces Crum to 1 point; winner-take-all wager executed.

segments.title: Hype Train Subscriber Acknowledgments
segments.notes: Hype Train appears for sub readings; Case deflects Hype Train's advances; brief exchange about Hype Train's nationality.

segments.title: How To: Remove Tags & Get Revenge
segments.notes: Jeb and Jeb's Dad (board spirit) present instructional videos on tag removal and escalating revenge tactics (flaming poop bags, mailing lists, police swatting, cement in convertible); Jeb's Dad displays apparent wood-manipulation anomalies.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid Attempt
segments.notes: Case announces DJC4/Justin Juice Powers theme deferred to Monday; attempts raid on 'statics' playing Hollow Knight; technical difficulties with raid command.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers ICE raids in Chicago with federal correspondent Rick defending warrantless arrests of U.S. citizen children. Peter Gibbon returns from the wall claiming cosmic resilience to host Amongst the Web. The Beyblade Tournament concludes with Munch defeating Crum 15-3, claiming 301 total points and reducing Crum to 1 point in a winner-take-all wager. Jeb and his board-bound father present a revenge-themed How To segment featuring anomalous wood manifestations. The DJC4/Justin Juice Powers theme song is deferred to Monday.
